name: CONTROL ROOM
text: The main operations center, glowing with the
steady hum of ancient, well-maintained
machinery. The worn floor panels suggest
decades of pacing and careful monitoring.

name: CONTROL CONSOLE
text: A massive array of dials, switches, and
screens, all bathed in the warm light of the
central display. The edges are scuffed,
showing layers of paint from previous

name: OPERATOR CHAIR
text: A sturdy, ergonomic seat on casters,
positioned before the left side of the control
board. The upholstery is cracked but looks
comfortable enough for long shifts.

name: OPERATOR CHAIR
text: The right-hand station's chair, identical to
the other but slightly more worn on the
armrests. It's angled as if someone just stood
up to check a reading.

name: SCHEMATIC HOLOGRAM
text: A bright orange, wireframe projection of what
looks like a power core or engine. The lines
waver slightly, a testament to the old
projection hardware.

name: WALL PIPE
text: A thick, dull grey conduit running vertically
down the wall. Condensation has stained the
metal just below a heavy joint.

name: WALL PIPE
text: Another vertical pipe, this one slightly
thinner, tucked into the corner. It hums with
a faint, low vibration.

name: WALL CONDUIT
text: A cluster of pipes curving down from the
ceiling before disappearing behind the main
display. The grey casing is scratched and
dented in several places.

name: STORAGE CANISTERS
text: Two small, cylindrical containers sitting by
the base of the console. One looks like it
might hold hydraulic fluid, the other
something more caustic.

name: TOOLBOX
text: A heavy, olive-drab metal case with a single
wrench resting on top. The latches are bright
where the paint has worn away from frequent
use.

name: OPEN LOGBOOK
text: A thick, leather-bound book lying open next to
an old-fashioned stylus. The pages are filled
with cramped, messy handwriting and hastily
sketched diagrams.

name: CLOSED MANUAL
text: A heavy, dog-eared technical manual resting
near the edge of the console. Its cover is
faded, and a wrench lies just behind it.

name: WALL CONDUIT
text: The horizontal section of piping that frames
the upper left of the main status board. It
looks sturdier than the other pipes in the
room.

name: RED BINDER
text: A thick, brightly colored binder sitting
upright between two panels. Its spine is
cracked, and several loose papers stick out
from the top.
